C1_duplicate_provenance.verdict: Duplicates come only from the iteration(s) shown; if 11 is absent, the probe's own stage contributes no duplicate pairs, so sigma_e is borrowed across plate formats.

C2_plate_offset.correction: The frozen analysis's sigma_b = 0 was a structural artefact: a file offset is constant within a file pair, so it cannot be estimated from a variance taken across wells. Report mean|offset| and sd(offset) instead.
C2_plate_offset.note: predicted vs observed variance of the pair mean is not directly comparable across pairs with different n; the informative quantities are the offset distribution and the fact that offsets are shared inside a file.

C3_level_mixed_se.note: Matching on the pair mean mis-assigns A673's O2 (0.63) to the [.75,1] bin; matching on each well's own level gives a larger SE for A673. No decision flips.

C4_power.correction: The frozen analysis paired a one-sided power z with a two-sided 1.96 criterion; the consistent figure is larger by (2.8016/2.4865)^2 = 1.269. Any plates-needed number also conditions on the observed dbar as if it were the true effect, which is not established for BJ.
C4_power.a673_plates_needed: not reportable (effect is ~10x the K=2 floor; the formula returns a fraction)

C5_placement.reference: within-file same-condition duplicate |d| at level [0.75,1], n=2453
C5_placement.correction: The frozen JSON reported the percentile of |dbar| against a null whose scale is sqrt(2)*sigma_e. The scale-matched statistic is |dbar|*sqrt(2). Both are descriptive yardsticks, not p-values.

C6_row_effect_blind_spot.bj_probe_rows: N22 vs O22 differ by exactly one row
C6_row_effect_blind_spot.note: A row offset cancels from sigma_e (duplicates share positions) and from an identical-layout comparison, yet enters the BJ contrast directly. Bounding it from high-control strips is the only handle available; if its bound is well below the BJ effect the negative survives, but the design cannot see this component.
